info.name: Smart Leave Management API Tests
info.description:
End-to-end API tests for the Smart Leave Management System.

**Setup**
1. Start the Spring Boot backend on http://localhost:8080 with MySQL running.
2. Import `Smart-Leave-Management.postman_environment.json` and select it.
3. Run the collection from the Collection Runner or `newman run` (see testing-guide.md).

The Authentication folder must run first: it captures the JWT for every role into
environment variables that all other folders reuse. Dates are computed at runtime
(never in the past, never overlapping the seeded demo data).

exec: // Next Monday (strictly in the future) so seeded demo data never collides
const plus = (d, n) => new Date(d.getTime() + n * 86400000);

item.name: Register employee (role can never be chosen)

exec: pm.test('Always EMPLOYEE even when role=ADMIN is posted', () => pm.expect(body.user.role).to.eql('EMPLOYEE'));

item.name: Balance is NOT deducted on submit
Manager sees the request in Pending

exec: pm.test('Request is visible to the reporting manager', () => pm.expect(found).to.be.true);

item.name: Rejection did not touch the balance
Apply then cancel own pending request

exec: pm.test('At least the three seeded departments', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().length).to.be.at.least(3));

item.name: PUT Restore leave entitlement to 12 days

exec: pm.test('Generic message (no account enumeration)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid email or password'));
pm.test('Same message as wrong password', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid email or password'));
pm.test('Clear message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('End date cannot be before start date'));
